title: 33rd sitting of the 20th Majlis
summary: The 33rd sitting, the last of the 20th Majlis's first session, was held on the evening of 22 August 2024. Members debated the Judicial Committee's report recommending that Prosecutor General Hussain Shameem be dismissed. MDP members argued the committee had been held in secret against the rules, while PNC and allied members defended the closure and criticised the Prosecutor General's record in court cases. The Majlis then voted 65 to 9 with 1 abstention to approve the dismissal, and the chair announced end-of-term figures and that the second session starts on 1 October 2024. Some words and names in the text layer are garbled, so speaker gists are approximate.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Nazil
positions: Argued the committee's closed proceedings and the report breached Majlis rules.
Asked the chair to confirm reports that the Prosecutor General had resigned before continuing.
Said the Prosecutor General answered only one question and the committee should have been open.

speakers.name: Mohamed Abbas
positions: Said the Prosecutor General should be removed over how past cases were handled.
Raised the reported resignation and urged the removal vote to go ahead.

speakers.name: Abdul Sattar Mohamed
positions: Said rule 46 covers sittings, not committees, and that rule 167 allows closed committees.
Supported removal whatever view is taken of the bottle photo.

speakers.name: Hussain Ziyad
positions: Voiced concern about growing use of closed committees while not opposing a Prosecutor General's removal.
Asked for confirmation of the reported resignation before voting.

speakers.name: Husnee Mubarik
positions: Presented the Judicial Committee report finding the Prosecutor General unfit for office under Article 228 and recommending his removal.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Didi
positions: Cited rules 185, 180 and 181 to say closed committee meetings are permitted, so the sitting was not against the rules.

speakers.name: Mauroof Zakir
positions: Raised a point of order objecting to the language used about the MDP parliamentary group leader.

speakers.name: Abdul Gafoor Moosa
positions: Raised a point of order asking the chair to clarify media reports that the Prosecutor General had resigned.

speakers.name: Hassan Zareer
positions: Said many prosecutions failed in court and he has no confidence in the Prosecutor General; fully supports the report.

speakers.name: Ahmed Aifan
positions: Said rule 46 does not support the objections about secrecy, and backed removing the Prosecutor General.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Naseem
positions: Said the committee followed rules 167 and 185, and the Prosecutor General answered only one question.

speakers.name: Abdulla Rifau
positions: Defended the committee's closure and criticised the Prosecutor General's handling of earlier cases; backed the report.

speakers.name: Ibrahim Muhammad
positions: Supported the report, citing the Prosecutor General's record and conduct.

decisions: The Majlis approved the Judicial Committee report and removed Prosecutor General Hussain Shameem from office, 65 to 9 with 1 abstention.
The chair said no resignation letter had reached the President's office or the Majlis Secretariat when the vote was held.
The chair announced the second session opens on 1 October 2024, with the first sitting on 3 or 7 October.
The chair said a new Prosecutor General must be appointed within 30 days, likely needing two sittings outside session with 3 days' notice.

votes.what: Removal of Prosecutor General Hussain Shameem from office (76 present, 38 needed)
